subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Capacity Planning Tests
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Capacity Planning Tests.

hook.text: Marketing plans a campaign that will double traffic next quarter. Can the current servers handle it?

buildup.text: Capacity planning tests determine the maximum throughput of current infrastructure under load.

discovery.text: By measuring current limits, teams predict exactly when they need to scale and by how much.

twist.text: Without data, teams either over-provision (wasting money) or under-provision (crashing under load).

climax.text: Tests show current capacity handles 8,000 users. Marketing expects 15,000. The team scales ahead.

punchline.text: Know your limits before your users discover them for you.

quiz.question: What does capacity planning prevent?
options: Over-provisioning or crashing under expected growth
